According to the field definition, separate elutions or enrichment steps are fractions, not technical replicates. Since these are slices of one gel lane from one sample, they are fractions. Technical replicates are repeated runs of the same material. Each slice is a different part of the material.
issue_summary.COMPLETENESS_CHECK: The mapping assigns index 1 to all runs, which is correct if they are not technical replicates of each other.
